purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software - patient insurance information CSV conversion/import processing (患者保険情報CSVファイルコンバート処理)
purpose.summary: This program converts patient insurance information from a CSV file into an indexed (ISAM) file for the ORCA medical receipt system. It reads a parameter file and input CSV, validates and transforms patient insurance records, and writes results to an indexed file while logging errors to an error file.

notable_features: INDEXED file with DYNAMIC access mode and composite key (ISAM-KEY)
LINE SEQUENTIAL file organization for CSV and error output
27 CALL statements (DB interface via MCP layer)
99 PERFORM statements with structured section-based design
No COMP-3 usage despite numeric fields
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars of a 101893-byte file. Comments are encoded in EUC-JP/Latin-1 rendering as mojibake in the excerpt. The program is clearly part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system, targeting OpenCOBOL/GnuCOBOL on Linux (/home/orca path). Revision history spans 2001-2006.
